status: 26 target figures attributed; 25 selected native JPEG assets; one target native representation explicitly unscored
scope: Research-only source association and report attribution. No image-fire classification, causal conclusion, authority promotion, new acquisition or camera-original authentication.

field_semantics.caption_summary: Paraphrase of the visible figure caption; the pinned complete page preserves exact wording.
field_semantics.report_attributed_floors: Floors identified in the caption or relevant local prose, not an exhaustive visible-floor inventory or independent floor authentication.
field_semantics.report_time: Source-reported timing and explicit basis/limits; numerical precision is not upgraded by formatting.
field_semantics.source_family: Conservative report-credit/view grouping; not proof of independent recording origins.

independence: No root/second observer image labels or observation records read. Source details withheld from the annotators before their full-record freezes. This reviewer did read the report captions/prose and inspect full pages and selected native JPEGs to establish associations.

source.ceiling: Preserved report-embedded imagery; original camera bytes/resolution not established

global_limits: All creator, location, architectural numbering and time attributions are NIST's unless explicitly stated otherwise; this review authenticates association with the held report, not historical truth.
A byte-identical report JPEG may already be cropped, enlarged, adjusted, overlaid or otherwise processed by the report producer; it is not established to be an original camera file.

Intervals obtained by expanding explicit +/- uncertainty are bookkeeping derivatives of the report statement, not probability distributions or independently validated bounds. Approximate or at-least uncertainty is not converted to a hard interval.
Figures from the same credited camera/video family and times inferred from shared fire/window states are dependent. Different asset IDs do not establish independent events or clocks.
Only the external region visible in the source is available. Floors/windows hidden by opacity or foreground structures and interior fire fields are not observed.
Source claims from moving clips, off-page frames, historical fire growth, flashover, wind, interior pathways and steel temperatures are not established by these static-image associations.
